name: Depravity Of Man
overview: The Scriptures reveal the profound depravity of man as seen in the days of Noah, where every thought and intention of the human heart was continuously evil, leading to widespread corruption and violence on the earth. God's grief and repentance over His creation highlight the severity of human sinfulness, prompting His judgment through the flood to cleanse the earth from this pervasive wickedness. This passage underscores humanity's fallen nature and the urgent need for redemption.
